node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one conic reduction
node.statement: For h=7, the residual order-one curve is 35u^2+14(11c^2+5c+11)u+120(c^4+c^2+1)=0 with u=rho*c*(c-1). Completing the square gives the reciprocal quartic D(c)=7(5u+A)^2. Under z=c+c^-1 and w=(5u+A)/c it is the conic 7w^2=247z^2+770z+775, followed by the single quadratic pullback c^2-zc+1=0.
node.notes: Exact h=7 geometry reduction. The conic chart retains its quadratic c-pullback and finite exceptional charts; reciprocal, Frobenius, torsion, cyclotomic, and inner conditions remain open.
